methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen compound-bow sights spanning fixed-multipin hunting sights to adjustable single-pin sliders and target scope housings, verified 2026-08-11 against manufacturer product/spec pages (Spot Hogg, Black Gold/Montana Black Gold, Feradyne/IQ, TruGlo, UltraView) and major specialty retailers (Lancaster Archery Supply, Bass Pro Shops, Walmart, Dragon Archery) who reproduce OEM spec sheets; each sight ships in multiple pin-count/pin-diameter configurations at different price points, so the specs and price recorded reflect one representative configuration (noted in priceNote) rather than every SKU variant. One adversarial correction was made to the seed list: the seed "Sight Master Slider" does not resolve to any current, verifiable product — Sight Master branded sights are a discontinued line with no maintained manufacturer site or current retailer listing, and the closest search hits were archived forum references and an unrelated Trophy Ridge "Drive" slider — so it was replaced with a real, currently-sold direct analog in the same target/slider-sight category, the Sure-Loc Challenger, kept in the entry's provenance note. priceUsd is left null wherever no manufacturer or major-retailer page could be directly confirmed for the specific representative configuration (CBE Trek Pro, Axcel Landslyde, Sure-Loc Challenger, TruGlo Range Rover, UltraView UV3) rather than inferring from a sibling model's price. accessedAt 2026-08-11 throughout.

products.name: Spot Hogg Fast Eddie XL MRT 5-Pin Bow Sight
products.priceNote: 5-pin .019" MRT configuration (Born and Raised Outdoors); Fast Eddie XL spans roughly $325 (double-pin, Lancaster Archery) to ~$450+ (7-pin) depending on configuration and retailer

specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Tool-less micro-click windage and elevation on HRD dovetail rail

products.provenance: Spot Hogg's own Fast Eddie XL product page confirms the newly designed 6 in. dovetail bar/bow mount, MRT (Multiple Ring Technology) housing, 1st/2nd/3rd axis adjustment, and pin sizes of .010/.019/.029, with configurations from single to 7-pin. Weight (14.6 oz) and the specific 5-pin .019" price ($404.99) corroborated at Born and Raised Outdoors; a double-pin build lists lower ($324.99, Lancaster Archery), reflecting the wide price spread across configurations for this model.

products.name: Spot Hogg Hogg Father MRT 3-Pin Bow Sight
products.priceNote: 3-pin .019" MRT configuration (S&S Archery); Hogg Father spans roughly $350 (single pin, on sale) to ~$550 (7-pin/Triple Stack) depending on configuration and retailer

specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Tool-less micro-adjust windage, elevation, and yardage pointer with quick-release knob

products.provenance: S&S Archery's listing (an authorized Spot Hogg dealer reproducing the manufacturer spec sheet) and Spot Hogg's own sights pages confirm the Hogg Father ships in single/double/3/5/7-pin MRT configurations with tool-less windage/elevation/yardage-pointer adjustment, a quick-release knob, and micro-adjustable 2nd/3rd axis. No manufacturer-published net weight was located for this model, so weight_oz is left null rather than assumed by analogy to the similarly built Fast Eddie XL.

products.name: HHA Optimizer Lite Ultra XL5519 Single-Pin Bow Sight
products.priceNote: XL5519 configuration (1-pin, .019" rheostat, 1-5/8 in. housing) at Walmart; .010" / 2 in.-housing variants run roughly $225-$280 across retailers

specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Tool-less micro windage adjustment; rack-and-pinion elevation dial for 20-80 yd range

products.provenance: Retailer listing (Walmart, reproducing HHA's own model/spec copy for the XL5519) confirms the 1-5/8 in. housing, .019" pin, and rheostat light; Bowhunting.net's hands-on review corroborates a 10 oz weight, 100% machined-aluminum build, 5 ft (60 in.) of .019" fiber optic on the moveable pin, 52 included DS-TAPES yardage tapes, and 20-80 yd adjustable range. No 2nd/3rd-axis leveling feature is documented for this model on any fetched source, so axis_leveling is left null.

products.name: HHA Tetra Max TMX-4510 4-Pin Bow Sight
products.priceNote: TMX-4510 (4-pin, .010") configuration at Lancaster Archery Supply; single-pin and Tournament Edition variants are priced separately (roughly $330-$460)

specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Two-stage micro-adjustable windage; brass rack-and-pinion elevation with 2.1 in. of travel

products.provenance: Lancaster Archery Supply's TMX-4510 listing (authorized HHA dealer reproducing manufacturer specs) prices this 4-pin .010" configuration at $379.95. Archery Business's field coverage corroborates the 1.625 in. pin housing, 2.1 in. of elevation travel, brass rack-and-pinion mechanism, two-stage micro-adjustable windage, and 2nd/3rd axis adjustability shared across the Tetra Max line. No net weight figure was found on any fetched source, so weight_oz is null; fiber-optic length is not separately published for this dual-pointer housing, so left null.

products.name: Black Gold Ascent Verdict 5-Pin Bow Sight
products.priceNote: 5-pin .019" configuration (Archery Depot regular price); single and 3-pin Verdict models are priced separately

specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Dial-of-Death re-indexing elevation with SureGrip knob; micro windage adjustment

products.provenance: Black Gold's own Ascent Verdict page confirms single/3-pin/5-pin options, the Dial-of-Death re-indexing elevation system with SureGrip knob, 1st/2nd/3rd axis adjustability, PhotoChromatic shell, 45-degree-viewable sight tape, and 54 included tapes. Mounted length (5.75-6.75 in.) and 1.75 in. housing size, plus "under 12 oz" weight (recorded as the 12 oz ceiling) and .019" Micro Groove pins, corroborated on Scheels' listing. Price $279.95 per Archery Depot's regular-price listing for the 5-pin build.

products.name: Black Gold Rush 5-Pin Bow Sight
products.priceNote: 5-pin .019" configuration at Lancaster Archery Supply; other retailers show $105-$140 for the same build

specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Calibrated gang vertical and horizontal adjustment

products.provenance: Black Gold's own Rush page confirms single/3-pin/5-pin options, .019" Micro Groove machined-aluminum pins, SkyCoil light gathering, PhotoChromatic shell, oversized clamping dovetails, and an interchangeable fluorescent peep-alignment ring. Housing ID (1.75 in.), weight (5.6 oz), and mounted dimensions (3-7/16 x 3-7/8 x 4-5/16 in.) are stated on the Rush spec sheet as reproduced by retailers. This is a fixed multi-pin sight (gang-calibrated, not a slider with a movable yardage tape), so micro_adjust_yardage_tape is false and no 2nd/3rd-axis feature is documented, so axis_leveling is null. Price $129.95 per Lancaster Archery Supply.

products.name: Trophy Ridge React Pro 5-Pin Bow Sight
products.priceNote: 5-pin configuration at Walmart; Podium Archer lists the same build at a $299.99 regular price, so street pricing varies by retailer

specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Micro-click windage and elevation with stainless steel no-slop brackets

products.provenance: Bass Pro Shops and Bear Archery listings (Bear Archery now owns/distributes Trophy Ridge and reproduces the manufacturer spec sheet) confirm 6061 aluminum construction, 9.5 oz weight, stainless-steel no-slop windage/elevation brackets, tool-free React Technology sight-in, precision-installed bubble level with 2nd/3rd axis leveling, and a Contrast Glo Ring with rheostat sight light. This is a fixed 5-pin sight tuned per-pin rather than a slider with a continuous yardage tape, so micro_adjust_yardage_tape is false. Price $219.99 at Walmart for the 5-pin build.

products.name: IQ Micro 3-Pin Bow Sight
products.priceNote: 3-pin .019" configuration at Walmart; the flagship 5-pin Micro is Feradyne's featured build and may price higher

specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Tool-free micro-adjust windage and elevation knobs and dials

products.provenance: Feradyne's own IQ Micro product page confirms all-aluminum construction, patented Retina Lock alignment technology, 50%-thinner bladed-pin fiber-optic containment, tool-free micro-adjust windage/elevation, an angled multi-mount bar, and laser-etched adjustment marks; weight (7.4 oz) corroborated via targettamers.com's hands-on review. This is a fixed multi-pin sight with no continuous slider tape, so micro_adjust_yardage_tape is false. Price $144.99 for the 3-pin .019" build at Walmart.

products.name: Sure-Loc Challenger 400 Target Sight (6 in. Frame)
products.priceNote: Sure-Loc does not publish direct consumer MSRP; the Challenger 400 (6 in. frame) is listed around $320 at specialty retailers such as Dragon Archery, but the exact current price was not confirmed via direct fetch, so left null rather than guessed

specs.pin_count: sold as scope/pin-ready frame (single up-pin or lens typically fitted separately)
specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: True .002 in. micro-adjustment for both windage and elevation; one-piece frame with rapid-travel locking knob

products.provenance: CORRECTED FROM SEED: the seed "Sight Master Slider" does not resolve to any current, manufacturer-supported product — Sight Master is a discontinued brand with no maintained site or current retailer listing found (only archived forum references). It was replaced with a real, currently-sold direct analog in the same adjustable target/slider-sight category: the Sure-Loc Challenger. Dragon Archery and OpticsPlanet listings (authorized Sure-Loc dealers) confirm the Challenger's one-piece frame, rapid-travel locking knob, true .002 in. micro-adjustment for windage and elevation, a mounting block/offset bracket/10-32 third-axis leveling block included in the package, and compatibility with all Sure-Loc accessories and sight tapes. The 6 in. frame weighs 8.78 oz (9 in. frame weighs 9.40 oz per the same sources). Pin/lens is fitted by the buyer to this frame, so pin_count and pin_diameter_in are not fixed manufacturer specs and are recorded accordingly; no directly fetchable current price was found, so priceUsd is null.

products.name: UltraView UV3 Target Scope Kit
products.priceNote: UltraView does not display direct consumer pricing on ultraviewarchery.com; the larger sibling UV3XL SE kit lists $249.99 (no lens) to $349.99 (with lens) at Lancaster Archery Supply, but the exact current price for the base UV3 kit was not confirmed via direct fetch, so left null rather than guessed

specs.pin_count: sold as scope/light housing (up-pin, dot, or lens fitted separately)
specs.windage_elevation_adjustability: Mounts via 10-32 threaded rod to any compatible sight (Axcel, Shibuya, Sure-Loc, B3, CBE, Spot Hogg, etc.); adjustment governed by the host sight

products.provenance: UltraView's own scopes collection and Lancaster Archery Supply's UV3 Target Scope Kit listing confirm the 31mm outside-diameter aircraft-grade 7075 aluminum housing (vs. 41mm on the UV3XL), the swappable UV Cartridge system for changing lens/pin-count/pin-size while retaining sight marks, a 5-LED light system with 10 brightness settings, LevelLight illuminated fluorescent level, waterproof rating, CR2025-battery power with auto-off, and universal 10-32 threaded-rod mounting to third-party sight frames (Axcel, Sure-Loc, CBE, Spot Hogg, etc.). This is a scope/light housing rather than a complete sight with its own yardage tape, so micro_adjust_yardage_tape is false and windage/elevation adjustability is governed by whatever host sight it is mounted to. No net weight or directly fetchable current base-kit price was located, so both are left null.
